_comment: Property references for the session logs that vibe-watch reads. Both the VS Code Copilot Chat log (`chat`) and the Copilot CLI log (`cli`) are JSON/JSONL files. Every key, event type, and JSON pointer the parsers look up is defined here so that field renames in the log formats only require editing this file -- no Rust changes. Values starting with `/` are JSON pointers (RFC 6901, relative to the object noted in each section's comment); all other values are plain object keys or literal match strings. Add new entries as the log formats grow.

chat._comment: VS Code Copilot Chat `.jsonl` delta journal. Each line is `{kind, k, v}`.

journal._comment: Top-level keys on every journal line.

header._comment: JSON pointers into the first journal line (`kind:0`) used to recognise a chat log.

session._comment: JSON pointers into the reconstructed session root object.

model._comment: Keys within the model metadata object.
model.name: name

request._comment: Keys (and pointers) within a single request object in the `requests` array.

response._comment: Keys, literal `kind` values, and pointers within a request's `response` array items.

skill._comment: Markers used to detect a skill read from a tool invocation message or URI.

cli._comment: Copilot CLI `events.jsonl`. Each line is a flat `{type, data, id, parentId, timestamp}` event.

event._comment: Top-level keys on every event line.

types._comment: Literal values of the event `type` field that the parser handles.

data._comment: Keys and pointers within an event's `data` object.

model_metrics._comment: Keys and pointers within a single model entry of `modelMetrics`.
